one_line: Sultan of Malwa and patron of Mandu’s hydraulic and palace engineering on the high plateau.

appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown Malwa complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, intense almond-shaped dark eyes with thoughtful gaze, slightly arched brows, default expression calm and observant as if surveying works.
appearance.hair: black hair kept short and tidy beneath a deep maroon conical turban wrapped in layered folds with a narrow pale-gold band and a small emerald-green fabric tassel at the left side, no large plume.
appearance.costume: A long knee-length cotton jama in muted ivory with a subtle all-over fine floral block-print in pale beige, overlapping front tied to the right with small maroon fabric cords, worn over loose straight khil‘at-style trousers in soft dull teal; a sleeveless quilted armor vest (padded coat) in dark indigo with narrow vertical stitching and simple brass tie-hooks at the front, fitted but not bulky; at the waist a broad maroon cloth kamarband wrapped twice and knotted on the left with one end hanging down, over which a simple brown leather belt with a small brass buckle supports his sword; over the shoulders a light-weight creamy-beige cotton shawl with a thin maroon border draped from the left shoulder and looping under the right arm, suggesting courtly grace; feet in sturdy brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes; minimal jewellery: a pair of small gold studs in the ears and one plain gold signet ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Indo-Persian sword (talwar) with a steel blade, a dark brown leather-wrapped hilt and a simple disc pommel, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings, usually held lightly in his left hand or resting at his left hip as he surveys Mandu’s tanks and palaces.

ref_desc: Ghiyas-ud-din Khalji appears as a mid-40s Malwa sultan with an ivory patterned jama, maroon turban and kamarband, dark indigo quilted vest, dull teal trousers, brown leather shoes and talwar, in an ivory-maroon-indigo-teal-brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style character sheet of Ghiyas-ud-din Khalji: a mid-40s Malwa sultan with an oval warm brown face, neat short beard and calm, observant dark eyes, wearing a deep maroon conical turban with a pale-gold band and small emerald-green tassel, a knee-length ivory cotton jama printed with fine pale floral motifs, a fitted dark indigo quilted armor vest over it, loose dull teal trousers, a broad maroon cloth kamarband and simple brown leather belt, a light creamy-beige shawl with maroon border draped from his left shoulder, small gold ear studs and one gold ring, brown upturned leather shoes, and a slightly curved talwar in a brown leather scabbard with brass fittings held at his left side; show him front, side and back, clearly revealing consistent face, hair, garments, and the ivory-maroon-indigo-teal-brown colour scheme.
